hubSubtitle: A Digital Civilization. For Everyone. Bridging ancient wisdom with future technology.
welcomeMessage: Welcome to the AfghanAI Hub. The Scriptorium on the left lists available agents. How may I assist you today?
featuresSubtitle: From poetry to business plans, ancient history to modern science. A collective of specialized AI agents at your command.
featureCreativity: Generate poetry, scripts, and artistic ideas. Design logos, compose music, and develop brand voices.
featureEducation: Get tutoring for exams like Kankor, study Quranic texts, or practice new languages with an AI coach.
featureBusiness: Formulate business strategies, analyze market intelligence, optimize processes, and predict ROI.
featureHealth: Check symptoms, get information on pharmaceuticals, and find support with a mental health companion.
featureTechnology: Generate code, design UI/UX from Figma, build APIs, and automate your entire deployment pipeline.
featureContentCreation: Write scripts, produce video podcasts, direct films, and manage entire ad campaigns.
howToUseSubtitle: Three simple steps to unlock a universe of knowledge.
howToStep1Desc: Browse the Scriptorium to find the specialized AI agent that best fits your task.
howToStep2Desc: Issue your request in the command bar in plain language. The Oracle will route it to the correct agent.
howToStep3Desc: Our dual-model system provides a fast, accurate, and contextually aware response in seconds.
founderQuote: We are not just building a tool; we are weaving a digital tapestry of our shared heritage, a bridge from our ancient past to a limitless future.
founderMsgP1: Welcome to the AfghanAI Hub. This project was born from a simple yet profound belief: that the immense intellectual and cultural wealth of our civilization should not be a relic of the past, but the very foundation of our future.
founderMsgP2: For generations, we have been the custodians of great poets, brilliant scientists, and profound thinkers. Today, we face a new frontier—the age of artificial intelligence. It is our duty, and our opportunity, to ensure that our values, our languages, and our stories are woven into the fabric of this new digital world.
founderMsgP3: The AfghanAI Hub is more than a platform; it is a digital House of Wisdom (Bayt al-Hikmah) for the 21st century. It is a place where a student in Herat can get help with her Kankor exams, a poet in Kandahar can find inspiration for a new ghazal, and an entrepreneur in Mazar-e-Sharif can build a business plan that respects our cultural context.
founderMsgP4: We built this with two core principles: 'Power Without Price' and 'Wisdom Without Weight'. By using a state-of-the-art, cost-optimized architecture, we can deliver this immense capability to everyone, on any device, without the heavy cost. It is a digital civilization that is accessible to all.
founderMsgP5: This is just the beginning. Join us in this renaissance. Let us build, learn, and dream together. Your journey starts now.
selectAgentPrompt: Select an agent from the list on the left to begin your interaction.
